TextBlock.Text: Regional security forces have recovered most of the facilities Meridian's hard-line faction seized. One airfield and port enclave has not come back, and the battery covering it is not the man-portable inventory the first reports described.

A naval force has arrived under a protection-and-evacuation pretext and demanded the coalition patrols suspend. A small foreign expeditionary detachment is supporting the enclave under a separate arrangement. Its fuel and ammunition arrive by routes we can see, which is the one advantage we have.
Local authorities have asked for a protected window to move civilians and emergency supplies out. That window, not a body count, is the objective.
